Attack on C.M. of Andhra
Pradesh
*21. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
SHRI R.P. GOEN KA:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government took note of
the seriousness of the attack on Chief
Minister of Andhra Pradesh by People's
War Group near Tirupati on 1st of October
this year;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
activities of the Left Wing extremists are on
rise in the country;
(c) whether the Central Intelligence
agencies have alerted the States on the threat
of lives of VVIPs by the Naxalites; and
(d) if so, the steps being taken to
strengthen the security provided to the
VVIPs like Chief Ministers ?
Construction of roa ds under
PMGSY in Himachal Pradesh
†*22. SHRI ANIL SHARMA: Will the
Minister of  RURAL DEVELOPMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
construction work of the roads sanctioned
under PMGSY in Himachal Pradesh during
2000-2001 and 2001-2002 has not been
completed till now;
(b) whether Government propose to
initiate any action against the contractors
who have failed to complete construction
of roads as per schedule;
(c) whether Government propose to
assign construction work of roads to
Himachal Pradesh Public Works
Department in future;
(d) whether Government have received
any proposal from Himachal Pradesh
Government under PMGS Y for 2002-
2003; and

Coal shortage
*23. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the country
would head towards a severe coal shortage
and the demand-supply gap is likely to
widen  from 55 million tonnes by the end
of Tenth Plan (2006-07) to about 95 million
tonnes at the end of Eleventh Five Year
Plan period;
(b) whether this would require doubling
of coal production to meet the projected
demand;
(c) if so, the details of the action plan in
this regard; and
(d) whether Government propose to
involve private sector in coal mining to
bridge this gap?
Textile package for J&K artisans
*24. SHRI B.J. PANDA:  Will the
Minister of TEXTILES be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have drawn
up a textile package for Jammu and Kashmir
artisans;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether such kind of package has
also been considered for the most backward
and cash-strapped State of Orissa; and
(d) if so, the  details thereof?
Missing of Computers alongwith
classified data
*25. SHRI K.B.KRISHNA MURTHY:
SHRI ABU ASIM AZMI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether there was a recent theft of
more than 20 computers from the DRDO
Delhi alongwith classified data on India's
defence strategy;
(b) if so, whether these stolen computers
stored sensitive data of the Institute of
Systems Studies and Analysis and
encryption data relating to India's nuclear
command; and
(c) if so, whether any probe has been
ordered through IB/RAW in this matter,
and if so, the progress made so far ?
Insecurity amongst women in
Delhi
†*26. SHRIMATI MAYA SINGH:
SHRI. NILOTPAL BASU:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that an
atmosphere of insecurity has prevailed
among women in Delhi as a result incidents
of eve teasing and rape of a foreigner;
(b) if so, the details of incidents that
occurred during last six months;
(c) the steps proposed to be taken by
Government to curb such incidents; and
(d) How does Delhi compare with other
Metros during the corresponding period
with city-wise details for Delhi, Mumbai,
Kolkata and Chennai ?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi

9
Reconstitution of Cantonment
Boards
†*27. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE  be pleased to state:
(a) whether all Cantonment Boards have
been reconstituted;
(b) if so, whether civilian
representatives have also been nominated
on these Boards; and
(c) if not, the names of the Boards where
such nominations have not been made and
by when these are proposed to be made?
Revised wage package for workers
of NTC mills
*28. SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
SHRI N.R. DASARI:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Supreme
Court has directed the Central Government
to work out a revised wage package within
four months for the National Textile
Corporation mill workers; and
(b) if so, the details and the action taken
by Government thereon?
Women personnel in Paramilitary
Forces

SHRI GHULAM NABI AZAD:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS
be pleased to state:

Private participation in coal trade
109. SHRI R.P. GOENKA: Will the
Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
has been formulated to liberalise norms for
allotment of captive blocks of coal mines to
private sector and permit trading of coal
through private participation; and
(b) if so, the details thereof, including the
specific blocks, if any, for such allotments?
Promoting coal sector in Madhya
Pradesh
110. SHRI P.K. MAHESHWARI: Will
the Minister of COAL be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
promote the coal sector in Madhya Pradesh
with the help of State Government; and
(b) if so, the details thereof?
Import of defective navigation
equipment by O.F., Medak
111. SHRI MURLI DEORA : Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Ordnance
Factory, Medak imported navigation
equipments;
(b) if so, the details and cost thereof;
(c) whether C & AG vide his report
No. 6 of 2003 has observed that these
equipments were defective and were not
verified and tested during the period of
warranty;
(d) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(e) the loss caused and action taken in
the matter?
Joint exercises between IAF and
British Special Air Services
112. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Indian Air Force is likely to
have joint exercises with British Special
Air Services;
(b) whether details in this regard have
been finalised; and
(c) when these exercises are likely to be
held?

2
Establishment of Defence
University in Haryana
113. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government propose to set
up a Defence University in Haryana;
(b) if so, the place where this University
is to be set up; and
(c) by when the work in this regard is
likely to start and the University would
become functional?
Production of SU-30 by HAL
114. MISS MABEL REBELLO:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that HAL propose
to bring out SU 30s next year;
(b) if so, whether our engineers are now
fully capable of manufacturing this in the
country, and how our engineers are proposed
to be trained; and
(c) whether all the problems which earlier
had dogged the engine system, have been
sorted out and a fully safe-proof system has
been developed by our own men?
Defence deals approved and
sanctioned
115. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the year-wise details of defence
deals/projects involving upgradation of
equipment/arms approved and sanctioned
in the last three years and the amount of
funds sanctioned therefor;
(b) whether all the approved projects/
deals have been completed;
(c) if so, the amount of funds utilized
till date;
(d) if not, the number of projects still
pending and when they are expected to be
completed; and
(e) whether any delay has occurred in
any deal/project and if so, the reasons
therefor?
Tripartite treaty for development of
AWACS
116. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has recently signed a Tripartite treaty with
Israel and Russia for developing AWACS;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the amount of funds involved in the
whole project; and
(d) the number of such AWACS planes
that would be developed and where they
would be deployed?
Development of indigenous
Airborne Early Warning and
Control System
117. SHRI C. RAMACHANDRAIAH:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether India has decided to develop
its indigenous Airborne Early Warning and
Control System;
(b) if so, whether help from other
countries will be sought for this project;
(c) if so, the countries whose help will
be obtained; and
(d) the details in thi s regard?

3
Medium of defence service
examinations
118. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to include Hindi to be one of the medium of
defence service examinations;
(b) if so, the reasons for such a decision;
whether this decision will put the aspiring
candidates from the Hindi region at an
advantageous position;
(c) whether Government propose to
include all recognized regional languages in
the question papers;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Chief of Defence Staff
